one_liner: CivicState is a watchlisted paid civic-letter workflow until demand and identity are operator-validated.
directive: Treat this as a draft EIR soul upgrade. Operator merge, not this artifact, upgrades authority.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read existing planning and implementation files.
Separated repo evidence from workspace-only market assumptions.
Used bottom-up revenue math from pricing tiers and submission volume assumptions.
Preserved surprise contradictions instead of smoothing them.

planningMethod.marketSizing: Bottom-up paid civic-letter jobs multiplied by blended AOV; all external demand figures are assumptions.
planningMethod.financialModel: Submissions multiplied by AOV minus average variable COGS and fixed platform/vendor costs.
planningMethod.validation: Do not promote from draft until conversion, deliverability, coverage, margin, and operator workload are measured.

customer.primary: United States residents with concrete civic concerns who want help researching, drafting, routing, and delivering official correspondence.
excluded: Users seeking legal advice or filings

tam.basis: 1,000,000 assumed annual paid civic-letter jobs at $12.50 blended AOV

sam.basis: 120,000 assumed reachable annual jobs at $12.50 blended AOV

som.basis: 4,800 annual paid campaigns at $12.50 blended AOV

revenueAssumptions: Launch year has 3,000 paid submissions at $12.50 AOV for $37,500 revenue [assumption: operator model].
Growth year has 12,000 paid submissions at $13.75 AOV for $165,000 revenue [assumption: operator model].
Scale test year has 48,000 paid submissions at $14.25 AOV for $684,000 revenue [assumption: operator model].
costAssumptions: Average launch COGS is $2.25 per paid submission [assumption: blended AI/email/review model].
DigitalOcean launch backend starts near $96/month [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md].
Local data/compliance vendors may add $50/month to $500/month [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; .planning/PROJECT.md].
sensitivityTests: If conversion is 1% instead of 3%, traffic must triple to hit the same revenue [assumption: funnel math].
If COGS reaches $7.50, launch-year gross profit falls to $15,000 [assumption: model sensitivity].
If inbox placement is 60% instead of 85%, refunds and trust risk can kill the loop [assumption: deliverability sensitivity].

alternatives.name: Manual email and phone calls
alternatives.position: Free incumbent; CivicState must save enough time and uncertainty to justify $5 [evidence: tests/payment.test.ts] to $25 [evidence: tests/payment.test.ts].

alternatives.name: Resistbot
alternatives.position: SMS civic messaging substitute; CivicState differentiates through research, citations, preview, payment, and tracking.

alternatives.name: Change.org
alternatives.position: Petition substitute; CivicState emphasizes individualized letters and routing.

alternatives.name: LegalZoom
alternatives.position: Document-drafting substitute; CivicState must stay outside legal advice.

holes: The registry says watchlist and not near-term investible BOS.
AI citation errors can create trust and compliance risk.
The repo identity conflicts with the product identity.
mitigations: Require operator ruling before wrk.vc promotion.
Run a paid beta before scaling.
Measure inbox placement and bounce suppression before open signup.
Keep citation verification and human review mandatory.
Rename, repurpose, or archive based on operator decision.
residualRisks: This may remain a research asset.
Payment processors may treat civic content as higher risk.
Free substitutes may cap willingness to pay.
A copied UX may outrun CivicState without proprietary data.

strategy.focus: Validate one paid civic-letter workflow before scaling distribution.
strategy.moat: Verified official contacts, citation library, delivery reputation, and compliance controls.
doNotDo: Public social features before moderation load is known

goToMarket.first100Customers: First 100 customers through concierge/manual acquisition plus narrow civic-job SEO tests [assumption: launch channel].
channels: Search pages for specific civic jobs

daily: Monitor bounce and spam complaint events.

constraints: Workspace-only research; external market claims are assumptions.
No legal advice, lobbying representation, or claim filings.
AI disclosure and content moderation are required.
Payment and delivery must be webhook/audit-log controlled.

aiWorkGovernance.disclosure: Every letter includes AI disclosure [evidence: apps/web/app/privacy/page.tsx].
aiWorkGovernance.verification: Citations must be programmatically verified before use [evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].
aiWorkGovernance.moderation: Threats are blocked and defamation-risk content is flagged [evidence: tests/api-routes.test.ts].
aiWorkGovernance.audit: Agent and audit logs are modeled in Prisma [evidence: packages/shared/prisma/schema.prisma].

unknowns: Actual COGS under production token usage
Payment processor risk posture for civic content

assumptionLedger.claim: First 100 customers can come from concierge plus SEO
One operator can run launch review
WrkPlug shared rails reduce infra and CAC burden
